comparison_policy: Direct performance comparisons among native SPA-Net, SPA-Net+ParT, and SPA-Net+JP-JEPA must use identical Track-A splits, labels, weighting, heads, and evaluation code. Track-B results are external response/stability studies unless a validated representation bridge and compatible labels exist.
phase3_near_term_sequence: freeze this evaluation and representation-bridge contract
define deterministic multifile sampling and unified event-table schema
build released-Sophon control-sample adapter on Track B
defer SPA-Net/ParT/JP-JEPA adapters until Track-A gate A1 is frozen
defer direct embedding ablations until native SPA-Net gate A3 is frozen

source_preflight.candidate_inventory_interpretation: The 698 rows are broad lexical discovery candidates. They are not 698 validated SPA-Net, ParT, JP-JEPA implementations, checkpoints, or usable model adapters.

track_b_bridge_policy.reason: Track B is currently frozen as a jet-free particle-level external dataset. A direct SPA-Net bridge requires a separately validated jet-clustering/constituent association contract and truth-assignment labels compatible with the Track-A task.
